summary: Antelope Enterprise Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing a September 10, 2026 Note Purchase Agreement with an accredited investor for a $6,000,000 8.00% convertible promissory note, issued in a registered direct offering that closed September 15, 2026, raising roughly $6 million gross before expenses. The note has no fixed maturity, is immediately due on bankruptcy-type events, and converts at 80% of the lowest three-day VWAP, subject to a 9.99% beneficial ownership cap, via an F-3 shelf takedown. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch dilutive resets and conversion overhang.
